
Treatment history matrix is the main output of the RMD file 'PISurveys_CLP_TreatmentHistoryMatrix' in analysis>CLP DLNM.

```{r set up dataframes}
#loading in data
treatment_history_matrix <- read_csv("~/IAPM Project/MAISRC-IAPM/analysis/CLP DLNM/filtered_treatment_history_matrix.csv")
IceOut_Predictions <- read_csv("~/IAPM Project/MAISRC-IAPM/exploration/PARsInventory/2. Ice out/pred_iceout26.csv")
Chl_A <- read_csv("G:/Shared drives/Walsh Lab/Projects/MAISRC IAPM/Data/MPCA/Chlorophyll A/MPCA_ChlorophyllA_2010_2025_Clean.csv")



#adding columns. CLP_trt will be main working dataframe
new_cols <- c(
  "Year", "County", "Trt", "Trt_Date", "acres_trt", "perc_lz_trt",
   "p.crispus_dens", "p.crispus_FO", 
   "Chl_A", "max_depth", "prop_lz"
)

# Add missing columns initialized as NA
missing_cols <- setdiff(new_cols, colnames(treatment_history_matrix))

treatment_history_matrix[missing_cols] <- NA
CLP_trt <- treatment_history_matrix

CLP_trt <- CLP_trt %>%
  mutate(date_lag0_before = as.Date(date_lag0_before)) %>%
  mutate(date_lag0_after = as.Date(date_lag0_after))

#load in lake area data
MN_lake_morphology <- read_csv("~/IAPM Project/MAISRC-IAPM/data/MN_Lakes_Areas.csv")
CLP_trt <- CLP_trt %>%
  left_join(
    MN_lake_morphology %>% select(DOW, LakeAreaAcres, LAKE_NAME, `15ft_LittoralZone_Acres`,
    Percentage_15ft_LittoralZone), 
    by = c("DOW" = "DOW")
  )

#change the 2s to 1s in the lag matrix. 2s were used to differentiate lag treatments where we knew the year but not the specific treatment date. For this analysis that doesn't matter, so changing it all to 1 or 0.
CLP_trt <- CLP_trt %>%
  mutate(across(11:18, ~ ifelse(.x == 2, 1, .x)))

#populated Trt column based on if there is a lag0 treatment. 1 = lake was treated that year, 0 = untreated
CLP_trt <- CLP_trt %>% 
  mutate(Trt = if_else(lag0_before == 1 | lag0_after == 1, 1, 0, missing = 0)) %>%
  mutate(Year = year(SURVEY_START)) %>%
  mutate(prop_lz = `15ft_LittoralZone_Acres`/LakeAreaAcres)



CLP_trt$acres_trt <- as.numeric(CLP_trt$perc_lz_trt)
#populate Trt_Date with the treatment date from lag0before and lag0after columns
CLP_trt <- CLP_trt %>%
  mutate(Trt_Date = coalesce(date_lag0_before, date_lag0_after)) %>%
  #same with acres treated
  mutate(acres_trt = coalesce(acres_lag0_before, acres_lag0_after)) %>%
  #calcualte percent littoral zone treated
  mutate(perc_lz_trt = (acres_trt / `15ft_LittoralZone_Acres`)*100)

#ice off dates from Jake's prediction model
IceOut_Predictions <- IceOut_Predictions %>%
  mutate(DOW = str_sub(ID, 5))

CLP_trt <- CLP_trt %>%
  left_join(
    IceOut_Predictions %>% select(winter.year, DOW, est),
    by = c("Year" = "winter.year", "DOW" = "DOW")
  ) %>%
  rename(Ice_off = est)


#Join chlorophyll A MPCA data
Chl_A <- Chl_A %>%
  mutate(ActivityDate = mdy(ActivityStartDate)) %>%
  mutate(year = year(as.Date(ActivityDate)))

#previous year, which month?
#CLP_trt <- CLP_trt %>%
#   left_join(
#     Chl_A %>% select(year, DOW, ResultMeasureValue, ActivityDate),
#     by = c("Year" = "year", "DOW" = "DOW")
#   ) %>%
#   rename(Chl_A = ResultMeasureValue)



```


```{r}
write.csv(CLP_trt, file = "~/IAPM Project/MAISRC-IAPM/analysis/MVerhoeven_2020_model/2026 data/CLP_trt.csv")
```
